note: Frozen in Phase 0 with schema.json. The data stream implements these definitions; the dashboard and the methodology page show them. A change here is a contract change, and bumps version.

periods.interval: half-open [start, end), on calendar days in the timezone, from the original UTC timestamps (never relabelled UTC days)
periods.note: All time is the default while history is short. A bounded period is offered only for period metrics. Deltas against an earlier period need comparable coverage in both; a missing baseline is unavailable, and a zero baseline with new activity is shown as new, never as a percentage.

metrics.label: Estimated model usage
metrics.definition: Sum of the token-priced usd of every model call in the cohort, at the list prices of pricingAsOf.
metrics.coverage: Priced calls of all calls in the cohort; unpriced calls add nothing and are counted as missing.
metrics.notes: An estimate from token counts, not a bill. Client-reported usage, unattributed usage and the hypothetical cost without caching are other figures, never added to this one.

metrics.label: Model calls
metrics.definition: Number of model API calls in the cohort, subagent calls included once.
metrics.coverage: Sessions with a metrics file of all sessions in the index.

metrics.label: Input cache reuse
metrics.definition: sum(cache_read_tokens) / sum(input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens) over the cohort, weighted by tokens; never an average of ratios.
metrics.coverage: Calls with token counts of all calls in the cohort.
metrics.notes: Unavailable when the denominator is zero. Cache reads are context processed again, not new input. Thinking tokens are part of output and play no part here.

metrics.label: Completed verification jobs
metrics.definition: Number of verification jobs with a result whose finishedAt falls in the period, passed or failed.
metrics.coverage: Results with a finishedAt of all results.
metrics.notes: Not filtered by model: too few jobs link to the session that submitted them. A passed job is one that ran as its steps expected; it may well have found a violation.

metrics.label: Median verification duration
metrics.definition: Median wallSeconds of the completed jobs in the period with a valid (positive, finite) value, shown with the number of jobs it is taken over.
metrics.coverage: Jobs with a valid wallSeconds of the completed jobs in the period.
metrics.notes: Per job. Summed job time is not factory wall time: jobs run in parallel.

metrics.label: Recorded changes
metrics.definition: Distinct jj change ids in the rollup at the source revision; trace-publication housekeeping counted apart.
metrics.coverage: Changes with at least one session of all changes.
metrics.notes: A total at the revision, not changes per period: the rollup has no commit times.

metrics.label: Examples in the catalog
metrics.definition: Examples in examples/index.json at the source revision, by origin (constructed, real-world), verdict, vacuity and freshness.
metrics.coverage: Examples with a verdict of all examples.
metrics.notes: A stock, never examples per period. A verified label is not a claim of a current, non-vacuous proof: freshness may be unknown and a proof may be vacuous.

metrics.label: Share of usage by model
metrics.definition: Each raw model id's usage_usd divided by the cohort's usage_usd.
metrics.notes: Describes where usage went; says nothing about which model is better. Different task mixes make models incomparable.

insights.template: {share} of input tokens were read from cache ({scope}).
The median verification job took {duration} ({n} jobs, {scope}).

separate.label: Client-reported usage
separate.note: Claude Code's own figure, where the session recorded one. Shown on the methodology page only.

separate.label: Unattributed usage
separate.note: Client-reported usage the calls don't account for. Methodology page only.
